description: Calls one other routine once, then calls two other routines in a loop whose count comes from a register value. It is called from two unnamed routines and calls three other routines in total.

name: spin_long_delay_loop
description: Counts down a fixed value of about 4,600 in a loop, acting as a delay. It was entered from a reference run and is called from two unnamed routines.

name: write_byte_pair_to_port
description: Writes two byte values to one address in sequence, with the second value overwriting the first. It was entered from a reference run and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: return_empty_routine_body
description: Does nothing and returns, so only the empty return is shown although the listed routine has 17 instructions. It was entered from a reference run and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: initialize_record_constants_and_callbacks
description: Stores its input and three fixed constants in record fields, stores two routine addresses as callback pointers, and copies a long value from a fixed location into a record field. It is called from one unnamed routine and calls two other routines.

name: program_register_block_values
description: Writes a fixed set of 16-bit and 32-bit constants into a register block addressed through a base register, using two stored record values, and ends with a word whose top bit is set. It was entered from a reference run and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: wait_register_bit_then_reset
description: Calls another routine, then polls a bit of a register-block field for a bounded number of passes, stopping early when that bit is set, and writes a fixed value to another field. It is called from two unnamed routines and calls one other routine.

name: spin_forever_in_loop
description: Enters an endless loop with no exit in the decompiled body. The listed facts show it touches the CIA B interrupt control register, and it is called from one unnamed routine.

name: program_register_block_and_poll
description: Writes a fixed set of values into a register block, calls another routine to obtain a value and writes it out, then polls one bit for a bounded number of passes before writing a fixed value again. It calls two other routines and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_ten_blocks_until_limit
description: Returns minus one when a condition flag is clear, otherwise copies ten blocks of 512 bytes from a table of source pointers into a destination, returning zero once the destination reaches a limit computed from two record fields. It calls one small routine that loads 255 and two other routines.

name: decode_sector_records_with_checksum
description: Scans for a fixed sync pattern, reads a header value, and for each of up to eleven records decodes 128 long words by merging masked odd and even bit halves while computing a checksum. It stops when the checksum is nonzero or the header is out of range, and stores each record's address in a table indexed by the header value. It calls two other routines.

name: decode_sector_records_by_count
description: Reads a header value and, for each record up to a counter, decodes 128 long words by merging masked odd and even bit halves and checks a running checksum, storing each record's address in a table indexed by the header value. Between records it skips a fixed sync pattern, and it calls three other routines.

name: merge_odd_even_bit_halves
description: Combines two long words by masking one with a fixed bit pattern, masking and shifting the other left by one bit, and merging the results. It is called from one unnamed routine and is referenced by an absolute move.

name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged, with no hardware or text references in the listed facts. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: return_empty_gap_stub
description: Only returns without doing anything, and it was found in a gap in the code. Its four instructions contain no calls or hardware references in the decompiled body.

name: compute_byte_from_two_fields
description: Combines a byte field with twice the low byte of a 16-bit field and stores the result in a fixed byte location, then calls another routine. It is called from one unnamed routine and calls one other routine.

name: fill_buffer_with_sync_pattern
description: Fills a buffer with a repeated long-word alternating bit pattern, then writes repeated copies of a two-word sync pattern at set offsets, calling other routines between writes and updating a counter until it reaches zero. It calls two other routines and a two-instruction OR merge routine.

name: clear_top_bit_if_flag
description: Clears the top bit of the byte at the current pointer when the byte just before it has its lowest bit set. It is called from two unnamed routines and is referenced by an absolute move.

name: clear_sign_bits_word_pairs
description: Walks pairs of long words, calling another routine for each pair, and clears the top bit of each value when the byte before its matching slot has its lowest bit set, then writes both values back. The count comes from a quarter of a 16-bit input. It is called from one unnamed routine and calls two other routines.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after another and returns. It is called from one unnamed routine and is referenced by an absolute move.

name: return_empty_stub_block
description: Does nothing and returns, so only the empty return is shown although the listed routine has ten instructions. It is called from one unnamed routine and is referenced by an absolute move.

name: build_crc16_lookup_table
description: Builds a 256-entry CRC lookup table by shifting each byte value through eight rounds that apply a fixed 16-bit polynomial, then stores the low and high bytes of each result in two tables. It was found in a reference run.

name: zero_word_block_fixed_address
description: Writes zero to a block of about 2,850 consecutive 16-bit words starting at a fixed address. The decompiled body shows only this clearing loop, although the region has 103 instructions, and the code was never loaded by a reference run.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)[cr Company].adf bytes 81920-82944 (code never loaded by a reference run):0:0000
name: return_empty_region_stub
description: Only returns, so the decompiled body does nothing, although the region has eight instructions and the listed facts show one other routine called. Its code was never loaded by a reference run.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)[cr Company].adf bytes 81920-82944 (code never loaded by a reference run):0:0014
name: scan_table_past_value
description: When its input is below 175, it advances through a table of words while each entry is at most the input, then returns. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)[cr Company].adf bytes 148480-148992 (code never loaded by a reference run):0:0000
name: return_empty_region_entry
description: Consists of a single return instruction, so it does nothing. Its code was never loaded by a reference run.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)[cr Company].adf bytes 149504-151040 (code never loaded by a reference run):0:0000
name: double_and_rotate_value
description: Doubles its input many times through repeated shifts, then combines the result with a bit-rotated copy of itself and returns the 32-bit value. The code is in a region that was never loaded by a reference run.

name: program_dma_wait_idle
description: Calls two routines through a function table held in its argument, writes a constant to a fixed location and a value to a DMA-related register block, then copies two values and waits while a status bit at a fixed register offset is set. It repeats the store and wait, and it was executed in a reference run.

name: enable_display_dma_channels
description: Writes a fixed value to a fixed location and writes a DMA control value that sets the master enable together with bitplane, copper, blitter and sprite channel bits. It was executed in a reference run and makes no calls.

name: call_table_entry_when_nonzero
description: When its second input is nonzero, it calls a routine through a function-table entry, and it returns its input values unchanged. It was executed in a reference run.

name: dispatch_on_two_codes
description: Calls the same function-table entry when its 16-bit input equals either of two specific values, and otherwise returns its input unchanged. It was found in a gap in the code and calls two other routines.

name: call_table_entry_referencing_highs
description: Calls a function-table entry and returns its inputs unchanged, and it references the text highs. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: call_table_entry_referencing_saves
description: Calls a function-table entry and returns its inputs unchanged, and it references the text saves. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: set_global_to_fixed_constant
description: Writes a fixed constant to two global locations and returns. It was executed in a reference run and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: call_indirect_from_table
description: Calls a routine through a pointer read from a table at an offset from a global base, then returns and performs no other operation. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: program_block_copy_registers
description: Optionally runs one other routine, then ORs fixed constants into two memory words, waits while a status bit is set, and writes pointer and size values to a register block. It repeats the wait and write with a second size value, calls one other routine and was executed in a reference run.

name: decompress_bitstream_to_buffer
description: The decompiled body is cut off partway through, but the visible part reads bits from a source area and copies bytes from literal runs or earlier output positions, which points to a decompression loop. It is called from one unnamed routine and its 145 instructions are only partly shown.

name: program_block_copy_twice
description: Writes two values into a register block, then waits while a status bit is set and writes pointer and size values twice with a busy wait between them. It was executed in a reference run and makes no calls.

name: copy_header_and_translate_rows
description: Copies header words from a source record into a destination, computes one derived word from two header values and clears two words. It then translates bytes through a fixed lookup table for a number of rows derived from the header, and it calls one other routine first.

name: copy_header_and_strided_rows
description: Copies header words from a source record into a destination, computes a derived word and clears two words, then copies a block of 16-bit words row by row from a source offset computed from the header. It was found in a gap in the code.

name: scan_records_calling_empty_entries
description: Walks a list of seven-word records whose count is in the first word, calling another routine for each record whose second long is zero, and returns the last value read. It was executed in a reference run and calls one other routine.

name: build_bit_reversal_table
description: Fills a 256-byte table so that each entry holds its index with the eight bits in reverse order. It was executed in a reference run and makes no calls.

name: start_blitter_copy_from_record
description: Checks that a source record is valid, then waits for the blitter busy flag to clear and programs the blitter with destination and source pointers, a mask, modulo, control words and size taken from the record and global settings. The listed registers are the blitter registers and the DMA control status register.

name: start_blitter_copy_simple
description: Starts a blitter copy from a source record when its pointer and a global value are valid, waiting for the blitter busy flag to clear before writing the pointers, control words, mask, modulo and size registers. The listed registers are the blitter registers and the DMA control status register.

name: store_value_and_run_sequence
description: Stores its input as the new current value and returns minus one when it matches the previous one, otherwise it runs a sequence of calls that waits on a result and stores a value derived from it. It references the text labels int2int2tom1, int2tom1 and tom1, and calls four other routines.

name: clear_block_after_offset_pointer
description: Adds 128 kilobytes to a stored base pointer and, when the result is nonzero, writes zero to 65,536 pairs of long words starting there. It was executed in a reference run and makes no calls.

name: find_node_value_by_key
description: Walks a linked list of variable-length nodes from a stored head, returning zero at the end of the list and the value stored in the node whose key matches the input. It returns minus one when no list is present, and it is called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_node_data_by_key
description: Walks the same kind of node list to find the node whose key matches the input, then copies its data words into an output buffer. It returns zero after copying, one at the end of the list, and minus one when no list is present, and it is called from one unnamed routine.

name: lookup_record_in_two_tables
description: Stores four table pointers derived from its base address, calls two other routines, then searches one table and then a second table of about fifty ten-byte entries for the input value, returning the value stored in the matching entry or zero. The facts list one instruction while the decompiled body is much longer, so the description covers only the decompiled body and was found in a gap in the code.

name: lookup_two_table_by_key
description: Stores four table pointers from its base address, calls two other routines, then searches two tables of about fifty ten-byte entries for the input value and returns the value stored in the matching entry, or zero when neither table matches. It is called from two unnamed routines and calls two other routines.

name: store_arguments_and_call_chain
description: Stores three input values into fixed memory slots and calls another routine, then when a counter input is nonnegative calls another routine, stores its nonnegative result and makes two more calls. It is called from one unnamed routine and calls four other routines.

name: copy_remainder_bytes_from_buffer
description: Divides its input by 512 and, when the quotient is zero or a routine reports success, copies the remainder in bytes from a buffer pointer held in a record field to the destination. It calls one other routine and returns zero on success or the failure value otherwise.

name: run_guarded_call_sequence
description: Stores four inputs in fixed memory slots, then runs a chain of calls that continues only while each result is nonnegative, storing two intermediate results and finally making one call selected by a global flag. It calls fourteen other routines in total and was found in a gap in the code.

name: call_one_of_two_routines
description: Tests a word through a record pointer and calls one routine, choosing between two routines that the decompiled body cannot tell apart. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: select_and_call_routine
description: Tests a word through a record pointer and calls one routine, choosing between two routines that the decompiled body cannot tell apart. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: branch_and_call_routine
description: Tests a word through a record pointer and calls one routine, choosing between two routines that the decompiled body cannot tell apart. It was found in a gap in the code, is called from two unnamed routines and calls three other routines.

name: do_nothing_return_stub
description: Only returns, so nothing happens in the decompiled body. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from two unnamed routines.

name: copy_block_remainder_from_base
description: Computes a source address from its base pointer and the quotient of its input divided by 512, then copies the remainder bytes into a buffer held in a record field when a routine reports success. It calls one other routine, returns zero on success or the failure value otherwise, and was found in a gap in the code.

name: match_entry_in_two_lists
description: Compares a stored key against the head of one of two lists, calling other routines to test each candidate, and records the matched list and entry in record fields when a test succeeds. It returns its input value, calls three other routines and was executed in a reference run.

name: store_failure_marker_on_error
description: Calls another routine, and when it fails or a second call fails, stores minus one at a pointer returned by the call, otherwise it returns its input values. It is called from three unnamed routines and calls one other routine.

name: store_failure_marker_after_checks
description: Calls another routine, and when it fails or a second call fails, stores minus one at a pointer returned by the call, otherwise it returns its input values. The decompiled body matches a neighbouring routine, and it is called from three unnamed routines.

name: fill_long_block_after_pointer
description: Stores its input at a pointer read from a record field, then writes zero to the following 127 long words. It was found in a gap in the code.

name: find_first_empty_entry_index
description: Searches up to fifty ten-byte entries in a table referenced by a record field for the first entry whose value is zero, and returns its index, or minus one when none is zero or the table is missing. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: clear_table_entry_by_index
description: When the table count is nonnegative, clears the ten-byte entry at the input index in a table referenced by a record field, then returns the input value. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: find_entry_index_by_key
description: Searches up to fifty ten-byte entries in a table referenced by a record field for the input value, returning its index, or minus one when it is not found or the table is missing. It was executed in a reference run and is called from two unnamed routines.

name: store_entry_fields_by_index
description: When the table count is nonnegative, writes a long, a word and another long into the ten-byte entry at the input index of a table referenced by a record field, then returns the input value. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: read_entry_value_by_index
description: Returns minus one when the table count is negative, otherwise returns the long value stored in the ten-byte entry at the input index of a table referenced by a record field. It was executed in a reference run and is called from two unnamed routines.

name: call_routine_and_pass_through
description: Calls one other routine and returns the input values unchanged. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: repeat_call_until_word_one
description: Repeatedly calls one other routine until a 16-bit value equal to one is reached. It was found in a gap in the code and is called from one unnamed routine.
